statement: Abelian rational Chow hard Lefschetz over Fpbar is classical; under the cited2026 CM-Hodge theorem rational and numerical equivalence agree and strict B holds
depends_on: Kunnemann1993 Theorems7.1/7.3; Soule1984 Theorem7; C.5a; for the strengthened clause D.4c-e, Milne1999 Theorem7.1 with erratum, Kahn2003 Theorem1.10, Milne2002 Theorem3.3
notes: Unconditional part settles both abelian C3 injectivities and A/A′/A″ over Fpbar. The stronger CH_Q=num_Q, Griffiths=0 and strict positivity are explicitly qualified by the same2026 primary preprint theorem input as D4e. No arbitrary nonconstant function-field claim, no complex-gate closure, and no image criterion with unrestricted source varieties.
